overview: Prove and empirically validate that one-layer transformers trained via gradient descent can provably learn a class of teacher models (CNN, GCN, sparse token selection, group-sparse linear predictors) by recovering their parameter blocks through a simplified position-only attention mechanism.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Define and manage global hyperparameters, task-specific configurations (CNN, GCN, Sparse Token Selection, Group Sparse Linear Predictor), data distributions (Gaussian, Exponential, Student-t, Gumbel), and training settings (learning rate, iterations, dimensions).

modules.name: Teacher Model Generator
modules.description: Implement the mathematical formulation of the teacher model f*(X) = σ(V*X S*) for the four specific tasks, including logic to construct the ground truth value matrix V* and the structured column-stochastic softmax score matrix S*.

modules.name: Positional Encoding Generator
modules.description: Implement the generation of the orthogonal positional encoding matrix P (D x D) used in the position-only attention mechanism of the student transformer.

modules.name: Data Pipeline (Synthetic)
modules.description: Implement data sampling logic for synthetic experiments, including generating input matrices X from various distributions (Gaussian for training, Exponential/Student-t/Gumbel for OOD testing) and computing noisy labels Y using the teacher model.

modules.name: Data Pipeline (Real - MNIST)
modules.description: Implement the real data pipeline for MNIST, including image patch extraction, positional encoding concatenation, training a baseline CNN to serve as the teacher, and extracting intermediate convolutional layer outputs as labels for the student transformer.

modules.name: Student Architecture
modules.description: Implement the one-layer transformer model with the simplified 'position-only' softmax self-attention formulation, featuring re-parameterized key-query matrices and the specified value matrix interaction.

modules.name: Loss Function
modules.description: Implement the population mean squared error (Frobenius norm squared) loss between the student transformer's predictions and the target labels, excluding the irreducible noise variance for excess loss computation.

modules.name: Training Engine
modules.description: Implement the gradient descent training loop for the student transformer on the population loss (approximated via online sampling), including the specific iterative update rules for the value matrix and key-query matrix.

modules.name: Metrics & Probing
modules.description: Calculate evaluation metrics during and after training, including excess training loss, out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization loss, Frobenius norm distance between learned and ground truth parameters, and cosine similarity between value matrices.

modules.name: Visualization Module
modules.description: Generate visual outputs for experimental validation, specifically log-log scale convergence plots for loss metrics, cosine similarity evolution curves, and heatmaps for the attention score matrix S(t) to compare against ground truth S*.

modules.name: Experiment Runner (Synthetic Tasks)
modules.description: Orchestrate the execution of synthetic data experiments for the four defined teacher models (CNN with Avg Pooling, GCN on Cycle Graph, Sparse Token Selection, Group Sparse Linear Predictor), coordinating data generation, training, and metric tracking.

modules.name: Experiment Runner (MNIST Task)
modules.description: Orchestrate the end-to-end MNIST experiment pipeline, managing the pre-training of the teacher CNN, extraction of the convolutional layer as the ground truth teacher, and subsequent training/evaluation of the student transformer to mimic the hidden layer outputs.
